subject: RFP: HelioTrust security questionnaire — SOC2/ISO attestation & evidence timeline
messages:
From: Caroline Summers <caroline.summers@heliotrust.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@heliotrust.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: HelioTrust RFP - SOC2/ISO questionnaire delivery

Hi Michael,

Thanks for taking this RFP — appreciate you moving quickly. Attached is our security questionnaire (SIG-lite + SOC2 crosswalk) and the RFP packet. High-level asks:

- Confirm whether Redwood can provide SOC 2 Type II report and ISO 27001 scope (we need dates).
- Fill the HT_SIG_Questionnaire.xlsx (control answers + evidence links).
- Provide an evidence index export (CSV) with artifacts by control owner.
- Confirm a preliminary delivery timeline for the first evidence bundle and the expected date for auditor access (KPMG will need read-only access).

Can you confirm scope and an estimated timeline by Monday EOD? Also copy your security point of contact — we may have follow-ups.

Attachments: HelioTrust_RFP_v1.pdf, HT_SIG_Questionnaire.xlsx

Thanks,
Caroline Summers
Senior Sourcing Manager
HelioTrust Mortgage
caroline.summers@heliotrust.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0123
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.inference.com>
To: Caroline Summers <caroline.summers@heliotrust.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HelioTrust RFP - SOC2/ISO questionnaire delivery

Hi Caroline — thanks for the packet and the clear asks. We can handle the SIG-lite + SOC2/ISO mapping; outline below:

Plan (high level)
- Week 1 (this week): Confirm scope (controls included for SOC 2 & ISO), owner assignments, and return a filled HT_SIG_Questionnaire.xlsx with high-level answers.
- Week 2: Deliver evidence-index.csv with links to artifacts (internal Drive + redacted copies) and an initial evidence bundle for high-priority controls.
- Week 3: Provide auditor access instructions (read-only) and schedule a short walk-through with KPMG.

Open items for you:
1) Can you confirm the audit window you expect KPMG to use?
2) Any specific controls you want us to prioritize for the first bundle? (data residency, key management, access reviews are common asks)

I’m looping in Mina (assurance lead) and Soojin (security ops) to pick up the questionnaire and start assembling the evidence index.

Attachments: none (referencing ones you sent)

Regards,
Michael Grant
Head of Customer Security Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference.com>
To: Caroline Summers <caroline.summers@heliotrust.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 08:26:00 -0800
Subject: SIG questionnaire — control map and initial evidence index

Hi Caroline / Michael,

We updated the HT_SIG_Questionnaire.xlsx with control-level answers for the SIG-lite sections and created an evidence-index.csv for the high-priority scope you noted. Highlights below:

- Completed sections: Organizational Policies, Access Management (IAM), Key Management (KMS), Logging & Monitoring, Incident Response.
- Evidence index includes: SOC2 report (redacted), ISO scope statement, KMS architecture diagram, sample access review logs, and retention policy PDF.
- Missing pieces: full KMS key rotation logs (engineering owner), historical access review exports older than 12 months (legal retention request).

Attached for this message: HT_SIG_Questionnaire_filled.xlsx, evidence-index.csv (CSV contains Drive links and proposed artifact owners). We flagged items requiring engineering or legal pull.

Next steps we propose:
- Karthik to coordinate extraction of key rotation logs and the HSM audit trail.
- Soojin to prepare a read-only auditor bundle and a link for KPMG.
- Michael to review and approve the bundle for delivery.

Attachments: HT_SIG_Questionnaire_filled.xlsx, evidence-index.csv

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Assurance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Caroline Summers <caroline.summers@heliotrust.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@heliotrust.com>, KPMG Audit <audit@kpmg.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — control map and initial evidence index

Thanks Mina — that looks like good progress. A few clarifications from our side:

- Audit window: target week of 2027-03-22 for KPMG on-site / remote review.
- Priority controls: please prioritize Key Management (KMS), Data Residency, and Incident Response evidence for the first delivery.
- For KMS logs — KPMG needs the HSM rotation trail + proof of rotation for the last 12 months. If rotation metadata is sensitive, we can accept a hashed/obfuscated extract as long as the auditor can validate integrity.

Procurement note: we will circulate a redlined MSA separately and ask for a DocuSign-ready copy. Please confirm who should receive the DocuSign envelope when ready.

Also looping KPMG — Hi, please confirm the minimum access you need for the initial evidence bundle.

Best,
Caroline
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Caroline Summers <caroline.summers@heliotrust.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.inference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — control map and initial evidence index

Caroline — thanks for the timeline. We can meet the 2027-03-22 audit window with the following commitments: 

Deliverables & owners (commitments)
- By 2027-02-19: HT_SIG_Questionnaire final answers (owner: Mina).
- By 2027-02-22: Evidence bundle v1 (KMS diagrams, policies, access review samples, retention policies) and evidence-index.csv (owner: Soojin).
- By 2027-03-05: KMS rotation extract (engineered extract; owner: Karthik). We will provide an obfuscated version if required and a KMS validation method for KPMG.
- By 2027-03-12: Auditor read-only access and walk-through scheduling (owner: Soojin).

Notes / constraints
- KMS rotation trails are stored in an HSM-backed audit store. We need a small engineering window to pull and sanitize data. Karthik: please confirm if we can produce a hashed audit extract and an HMAC validation key for KPMG.
- Redlined MSA: please send the redline link; copy legal@redwood.inference.com (we will add legal if signoff needed).

For DocuSign, send the envelope to agreements@redwood.inference.com — I will triage routing to our contracts team.
